title: Brain–Computer Interfaces
businessQuestion: What medical indications clear regulatory pathways before consumer neural telemetry arrives?
investorQuestion: Can non-invasive signal acquisition achieve clinical fidelity without implant risk?
overview: A small, bifurcated field: implantable clinical systems with long regulatory paths, and non-invasive headsets already shipping at low volume. The records track both, but commercial evidence is concentrated in neuro-rehabilitation and research use, not consumer control. Clinical milestones, not hardware demos, are the signal to watch.
